name: PDF Reader
description: A local page-by-page PDF reader with selectable text, cached per-page Markdown, and agent-powered translation and explanations.

commands.title: Translate selected PDF text
commands.description: Translate only the selected PDF passage into the requested target language using the saved Text Translation Agent.

commands.title: Explain selected PDF text simply
commands.description: Explain the selected passage using the matching page and surrounding context from the cached PDF Markdown files with the saved PDF Markdown Simplification Agent.

commands.title: Cache PDF Markdown pages
commands.description: Save or verify locally extracted Markdown pages in the PDF Reader's per-document cache.
